article_title: Norway's Haakon remembers 'my dear father' in first speech as king

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: King Haakon VIII's first national speech, his tribute to Harald V and the challenges facing his reign
Norway's decision to abolish the monarchy immediately after Harald's death
A dispute about who should become Norway's prime minister
Plans for an elaborate coronation based on an old Norwegian tradition
tasks.correct_answer: King Haakon VIII's first national speech, his tribute to Harald V and the challenges facing his reign
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בנאומו הראשון של המלך החדש, במחווה לאביו ובאתגרים האישיים והציבוריים שלפניו.

tasks.prompt: How did Haakon describe the kind of king he wished to be?
options: Distant and politically powerful
Present and attentive
Silent during national crises
Focused only on royal ceremonies
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האקון אמר שהוא מבקש להיות present and attentive — נוכח וקשוב.

tasks.prompt: What formal step will Haakon take in parliament on Tuesday?
options: Announce the date of his father's funeral
Appoint a new prime minister
Swear an oath of allegiance
Deliver a judgment in his stepson's appeal
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ביום שלישי המלך החדש צפוי להישבע שבועת אמונים בפרלמנט.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article describe Haakon's new role as beginning at a difficult time?
options: Norway has prohibited public mourning
Harald left no guidance about royal duties
Haakon refuses to work while caring for his wife
The royal family faces health problems, scandals and declining public support
tasks.correct_answer: The royal family faces health problems, scandals and declining public support
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה שילוב של מצבה הבריאותי של אשתו, מחלוקות משפחתיות וירידה בתמיכה במלוכה.

tasks.prompt: What does “choke back tears” mean in the account of Haakon's speech?
options: Stop speaking because of anger
Try to prevent oneself from crying
Read a prepared speech very quickly
Hide information from the public
tasks.correct_answer: Try to prevent oneself from crying
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי choke back tears פירושו להתאמץ לעצור את הדמעות ולא לבכות.

tasks.prompt: What does “remain steadfast” mean in Haakon's comment about difficult times?
options: Leave one's responsibilities to other people
Avoid discussing family relationships
Stay firm, loyal and emotionally strong
Return to an earlier style of monarchy
tasks.correct_answer: Stay firm, loyal and emotionally strong
tasks.explanation_hebrew: remain steadfast פירושו להישאר יציב, נאמן וחזק גם בתקופות קשות.

tasks.prompt: Give four details Haakon used to remember his father as both a family member and a monarch.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב פרטים על תפקידו המשפחתי של האראלד ועל דמותו הציבורית או ערכיו.
expected_points: Haakon thanked Harald for being a good father
He called him a warm and funny grandfather
He described him as a loving and caring husband to Queen Sonja
Harald brought the family together with natural authority
Harald encouraged family members to find their own style and be themselves
He stayed true to his values and commitments
He was viewed as a moderniser and a people's king
He reigned for 35 years

tasks.prompt: How might Haakon's message of unity respond indirectly to the royal family's recent difficulties?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין דברי המלך על חוק, שוויון ועמידה יחד לבין המשברים המתוארים, בלי לטעון שהוא הזכיר אותם במפורש.
expected_points: He did not directly name the controversies
He emphasised a society based on law and justice
He said everyone is of equal value
He described family solidarity as important during difficult times
The message may acknowledge public concern without debating individual cases
His wife's health creates personal and official pressures
Scandals involving relatives have damaged the royal family's image
A unifying tone may help him establish trust at the start of his reign

tasks.prompt: Summarise Haakon's tribute, his plans as king and the principal challenges described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מות האראלד, המסר המרכזי בנאום, צעדים רשמיים קרובים ואתגרי המשפחה והמלוכה.
expected_points: Harald V died aged 89 after a 35-year reign
Haakon VIII paid an emotional tribute to him as a father and king
Haakon promised to be present and attentive
He stressed law, justice, equality and national unity
Norwegians gathered with flowers, candles and tributes
Haakon will swear allegiance in parliament and later attend a consecration service
Queen Mette-Marit's health affects his new responsibilities
Several family controversies have attracted scrutiny
Support for the monarchy fell from 72% in 2024 to 54% in a recent poll
Experts nevertheless describe Haakon as respected and hard-working

tasks.prompt: Write a short opening message for a new head of state following the death of a respected predecessor. Draw on at least three ideas from Haakon's speech.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח מסר מכבד באנגלית המשלב אבל אישי, המשכיות, שירות לציבור ואחדות.
expected_points: Thank the predecessor for personal or public service
Recognise the public's shared grief
Express readiness to accept the new responsibility
Promise to be present and attentive
Emphasise law, justice and equal value
Commit to understanding different people's lives
Encourage unity during both good and difficult times
Use a sincere but appropriately formal tone
